messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: customer Solentra opened a dispute, invoice #79210 shows both a platform fee and a line labeled 'migration credit' as a positive amount. They claim double-billed.
Sasha: Can you paste the invoice lines?
Ravi: ```79210
PLATFORM_FEE | Annual | $10,000
PLATFORM_FEE | Migration Credit | $10,000```
Helen: That looks like the credit landed as a charge (missing negative sign). We normally apply migration credits as negative invoice lines on renewal, not as separate same-period credits.
Marco: On contract the migration credit is described as "applied to the first renewal" and not refundable. But customers read the invoice and think they were charged twice.
Avery: Billing system shows ingestion created two positive line items because of a mapping bug from our migration tooling. I think it's an AR posting issue.
Ravi: Customer already paid the invoice. They want the overcharge refunded.
billing-bot: Invoice 79210 status changed to "Paid" (stripe_tx_ab12).
Gabe: We have three remediation options: 1) issue refund for $10k, 2) create credit note to offset next renewal and keep current cash, 3) do nothing (bad).
Sasha: CS prefers refund to keep the relationship warm. Legal also flagged this as a material invoice error.
Helen: Finance: do we have precedent? Last year we issued a refund to Acme when a similar ingestion bug posted signs wrong.
Marco: We should also fix the ingestion mapping to prevent recurrence. Ticketing: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILLING-3499 created.
Avery: I'll attach logs and PR that caused the sign flip.
Ravi: CFO approval required for refunds >$5k per policy. Looping @Gabe for sign-off.
Gabe: I approve the refund. Please route through payment ops and create a corrective credit memo for audit.
Sasha: Action items: 1) @Avery file bug + hotfix, 2) @Ravi initiate refund and post refund id, 3) @Helen create CN-79210-1 (-$10,000) for bookkeeping, 4) notify CS for outbound comms.
Ravi: Refund started to original card, refund_id rfd_f7c9. Bank ETA 3-7 business days. Posting memo to BILLING-3499.
billng-bot: Note: typo in bot name above intentionally to mimic quick convo.
Avery: Hotfix merged and deployed, ingestion unit tests updated. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/421
Helen: I'll adjust renewal forecast and remove duplicated platform fee. Also will update AR aging.
Sasha: Draft outbound to Solentra: apology, refund id, summary of root cause, and confirmation of corrected renewal amount. I'll share draft in #customer-comms.
Ravi: Once refund clears, CS will close the dispute. Thanks team.
